Log changed laterality/exposure; stop if control cannot be restored.

progression:
Medicine Ball Step-In Shot Put — forward-facing single arm changes the controlled plant-to-release task to the arm opposite the stepping foot, while Walk-In Broad Jump — step-close forward takeoff directs the step-close leg impulse forward. The wall push ends upright without a loaded hand reception, and the step reversal remains grounded; the lower rotational unwind and upper drop-step press add separate controlled turn constraints. Compared with Class 25, prescribed ball releases change from 10 to 8, bilateral foot-landing events change from 4 to 2, explosive set/side bouts change from 11 to 10. With actual recovery and the complete travel envelope checked, require a balanced opposite-foot release and controlled forward landing. Use the fixed-stance forward-facing shot put for remaining E1 attempts if step timing fails, and a stationary broad jump for remaining E2 attempts if entry or total travel cannot fit. Record removed steps without inventing removed hand landings, since the wall task prescribes none.

Previous combined Class 25 prescribed 8 primary bouts and 47 conventional/traverse reps plus 0 cycles; this class prescribes 11 bouts, 57 reps and 2 cycles.
